name: Cline
freeTierNote: Open Source $0, BYOK, inference at cost.
bestFor: VS Code users who want an autonomous agent without switching IDEs
skipIf: You refuse to manage API keys
keyFeatures: Lives directly inside standard VS Code
Supports Anthropic, OpenAI, and OpenRouter keys
limitations: Unbounded agent loops can run up API bills if uncapped
Requires setting up and managing provider API keys
summary: Bring-your-own-key coding agent in VS Code. Cost is honest because you see the provider invoice.
body: Cline (and similar BYO-key agents) is how you learn what an agent actually spends. There is no bundled “unlimited Pro.” You plug in Anthropic, OpenAI, or OpenRouter and watch. That is healthier than a flat $20 that hides a credit pool. Extension and site checked 16 Sep 2026.
notes: Set hard spend limits on the provider dashboard
Review diffs like a human junior
